name: Censer of Controlling Air Elementals

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Summon an Air Elemental
powers.text: Magic action (once per dawn): An Air Elemental appears in the space nearest you; it obeys you while you concentrate, up to an hour.

summary: Once a day, summon an Air Elemental that obeys you (Concentration, up to 1 hour).
text: With the censer in hand, take a Magic action to call forth an Air Elemental into the unoccupied space nearest the censer. The elemental regards you and your companions as allies and carries out your orders. It remains for up to 1 hour, provided you hold Concentration on it just as you would for a spell. After that the censer is spent until the next dawn.
